sections.Aims and Fit of Module: To introduce topics in Statistics and to describe and discuss the potential scope of their applications. To describe the scope of the application of these methods.
sections.Learning outcomes: A. Describe statistical data. B. Use the Binomial, Poisson, Exponential and Normal distributions. C. Perform simple goodness-of-fit tests.
sections.Method of teaching and learning: This module will be delivered by a combination of formal lectures and tutorials.
